Maya (CS): Heads-up: Drift in CoralPay onboarding. p95 climbed from ~260ms to ~520ms in 36h, token spend +32%. Renewal in 7 weeks. Recommend proactive compact-model pilot + routing safeguard. Thoughts?

Ethan (Solutions): Do we have prompt-length histogram? Is it more long prompts or repeated short ones?

Maya (CS): Ops shows average prompt_tokens moved 140 -> 360; new multi-turn flows introduced.

Ravi (SRE): Quick wins: 1) route prompts >550 tokens to rw-base-3b, 2) canary rw-compact-2-int8 for <=550 tokens (start 12%), 3) enable prefix KV caching TTL=45s for opener messages.

Maya (CS): Customer note draft: "We can lower latency & monthly inference spend by ~20% with a targeted compact-model pilot. We'll monitor quality against your golden prompts and pause if you prefer."

Ethan (Solutions): I'll run a quality sweep on their golden set (n=700). Acceptance: intent parity >=98% and semantic drop <=1.5%. Rollout: 12% -> 40% -> 100% with automatic rollback on regressions.

Ravi (SRE): Instrumentation: ab_label=coral_compact_pilot, token_delta logs, and alert if p95 rises >14% or quality delta >1.5%. Also capture latency by prompt_bucket. ETA 3 hours to deploy hooks.

notifybot: [sched-bot] coral-compact-pilot scheduled 2026-03-22T15:00Z (12% traffic)

Maya (CS): I'll request customer approval and book a 20m walkthrough. Will include estimated monthly savings in renewal notes.

Ethan (Solutions): Also propose a small manual QA on 40 long-context prompts; if >2 fails, abort canary.

Ravi (SRE): Agreed. Starting canary now. Will post p50/p95/token-rate and quality delta in ~6h.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the source of truth for CoralPay compact pilot.
